questions.question: How should I have the remediation worker handle docs/ISSUES_20260102.md?

options.label: Remove the file entirely (Recommended)
options.description: Delete docs/ISSUES_20260102.md from dstrader main. Cleanest — dated internal triage notes don't add public value, and removal kills all three findings (auto-login internals, GPG fingerprint + prod path, log lines) in one shot. Loses the historical artifact from the public repo but you keep it in your private bundles.

options.label: Redact in place
options.description: Strip §2 (auto-login internals + log lines) and §5 (GPG key ID + /root/... path). Keeps the dated triage signal as a public artifact for showing historical work, but removes the operational detail. More surgical edit; worker would diff carefully.

options.label: Move to docs/internal/ + gitignore
options.description: git-mv docs/ISSUES_20260102.md to docs/internal/ISSUES_20260102.md AND add `docs/internal/` to .gitignore. File stays on disk for you locally but stops being tracked. Future internal-only docs land here too.

options.label: I want to read the file myself first

questions.question: The Dani first-name in IB-account labels (8 spots) — keep or anonymize?

options.label: Keep as-is
options.description: v1 review missed it; you implicitly accepted it then. It's a first name only, no surname; account labels are human-readable strings used in documentation. Low risk for a personal trading repo.

options.label: Anonymize to generic labels
options.description: Replace "Dani Growth 1/2" with "Growth 1/2" or "Account 1/2" (or similar) across AGENTS.md / SETUP.md / INTEGRATIONS.md / SUBSYSTEM_TRADING_ENGINE.md / ISSUES_20260102.md. Worker does it in the same commit as the ISSUES remediation.

questions.question: DEVELOPMENT.md stale `.idea/`-is-committed prose — fix in this remediation pass?

options.label: Fix in the same commit (Recommended)
options.description: Worker updates §1 line ~27 and the IDE-setup section to reflect that `.idea/` is now gitignored. Cheap to bundle with the ISSUES remediation.

options.label: Leave for follow-up
options.description: It's accurate that `DSTrader.iml` is still tracked; only the `.idea/` half is stale. Minor enough to fix in the next periodic sync instead of slowing this one.

questions.question: After remediation lands, restart the 24h pause clock?

options.label: Restart — substantive change warrants it
options.description: BLOCK-class findings being remediated changes the public-facing surface in a non-trivial way. The 24h pause is the SOP's built-in "sleep on it" safeguard — worth honoring for this one.

options.label: Skip again — small targeted edits
options.description: The remediation is bounded (1 file delete OR redact + maybe Dani rename + DEV.md fix), not a behavior change. You waived the pause for the v1→v2 cosmetic delta; skip again.
